description_ja: 重症化リスク因子あり。日本の実測入院率、入院死亡、生命表QALY、感染後1年EQ-5Dプロファイルを用いる投稿用主解析。
description_en: Publication base case for high-risk household contacts using Japanese hospitalization, inpatient mortality, life-table QALYs, and a directly integrated one-year post-acute EQ-5D profile.

description_ja: 感染後1年のQALY損失と直接医療費を除外する構造感度分析。
description_en: Structural sensitivity analysis excluding all post-acute QALY loss and direct medical cost.

description_ja: 急性期死亡回避を除外し、症状、入院、感染後QALYのみを評価。
description_en: Structural sensitivity analysis excluding acute mortality benefit.

description_ja: 外来症状と外来費用の回避だけを含む下限シナリオ。
description_en: Lower-bound scenario limited to outpatient symptomatic illness and outpatient cost.

description_ja: 対面初診と調剤を行うが、投与前検査を別途算定しない経路。
description_en: Face-to-face consultation and dispensing without separately billed pre-PEP testing.

description_ja: オンライン初診と調剤を行い、投与前検査を別途算定しない経路。
description_en: Telemedicine consultation and dispensing without separately billed pre-PEP testing.

description_ja: オンライン初診に加え、抗原検査と調剤を算定する経路。
description_en: Telemedicine consultation plus antigen testing and dispensing.

description_ja: JMDC研究の65歳以上無治療群の入院率1.298%を使用。
description_en: Uses the 1.298% hospitalization risk observed among untreated patients aged 65 years or older in the JMDC study.

description_ja: 旧日本CEAの症候性後入院率1.77%を使用。
description_en: Uses the 1.77% hospitalization risk from the earlier Japanese treatment CEA.

description_ja: 基準入院率に免疫不全患者の入院率比2.60を外挿した探索的解析。
description_en: Exploratory immunocompromised scenario applying a 2.60 hospitalization-rate multiplier to the base risk.

description_ja: 生存した症候性COVID-19 1例当たり感染後直接医療費5万円。
description_en: Adds JPY 50,000 post-acute direct medical cost per surviving symptomatic case.

description_ja: 生存した症候性COVID-19 1例当たり感染後直接医療費10万円。
description_en: Adds JPY 100,000 post-acute direct medical cost per surviving symptomatic case.

description_ja: 生存した症候性COVID-19 1例当たり感染後直接医療費20万円。
description_en: Adds JPY 200,000 post-acute direct medical cost per surviving symptomatic case.

description_ja: v0.1のICU・人工呼吸器分岐とPCC incidence-durationモデルを再現する構造感度分析。
description_en: Structural sensitivity analysis retaining the v0.1 ICU, ventilation, and PCC incidence-duration model.

description_ja: 症候性COVID-19後の入院確率10%とし、急性死亡時の残存QALYを85歳proxy（5.32 QALY）に同時変更する非常に高リスクな探索的解析。
description_en: Hypothetical very-high-risk scenario with 10% hospitalization conditional on symptomatic COVID-19 and remaining QALYs per acute death recalibrated to an age-85 proxy (5.32 QALYs); the 10% value was not observed in any Japanese source used in the model.

description_ja: SCORPIO-PEP全体集団の発症率と低い入院リスクを用いる探索的解析。
description_en: Exploratory overall-trial population analysis with a lower hospitalization risk.

description_ja: 全感染エンドポイントと無症候感染後PCCを含む旧構造の探索的解析。
description_en: Legacy exploratory model using the all-infection endpoint and PCC after asymptomatic infection.

description_ja: 全原因入院の50%のみをCOVID-19帰属とする構造感度分析。
description_en: Structural sensitivity analysis attributing 50% of observed all-cause hospitalizations to COVID-19.

description_ja: 全原因入院をCOVID-19に帰属させず、入院・死亡便益を除外する構造感度分析。
description_en: Structural sensitivity analysis attributing none of the all-cause hospitalizations to COVID-19.

description_ja: 日本高リスク外来研究の悪性腫瘍OR 3.941を基準入院率に外挿。
description_en: Exploratory malignancy scenario using the Japanese outpatient odds ratio of 3.941.

description_ja: 日本高リスク外来研究の腎疾患OR 2.003を基準入院率に外挿。
description_en: Exploratory renal-disease scenario using the Japanese outpatient odds ratio of 2.003.

description_ja: 日本高リスク外来研究の免疫抑制薬使用OR 1.637を基準入院率に外挿。
description_en: Exploratory immunosuppressive-drug scenario using the Japanese outpatient odds ratio of 1.637.

description_ja: 国内claims研究のB細胞枯渇療法aIRR 5.10を基準入院率に外挿。
description_en: Exploratory B-cell-depleting-therapy scenario applying a hospitalization aIRR of 5.10.

description_ja: 急性死亡時の残存QALYを年齢75歳proxyで校正。
description_en: Mortality-QALY scenario calibrated to an age-75 proxy cohort.

description_ja: 急性死亡時の残存QALYを年齢85歳proxyで校正。
description_en: Mortality-QALY scenario calibrated to an age-85 proxy cohort.

description_ja: 高リスク群の無予防リスクに全体集団RR 0.33を適用する保守的効果シナリオ。
description_en: Conservative efficacy scenario applying the overall-trial risk ratio of 0.33 to the high-risk untreated risk.

description_ja: 感染後utility差を6か月までに限定し、6-12か月区間を除外。
description_en: Conservative post-acute scenario excluding the recalled utility difference from months 6 to 12.

description_ja: 感染後1年QALY損失を主解析値の50%に縮小。
description_en: Conservative attenuation scenario using 50% of the base-case post-acute QALY loss.

description_ja: breakthrough症例の50%にエンシトレルビル治療を行う探索的整合性シナリオ。
description_en: Exploratory internally consistent scenario with 50% ensitrelvir treatment uptake after symptomatic breakthrough, adding acquisition cost and using a weighted hospitalization risk. Additional consultation, testing, and dispensing costs associated with post-diagnosis treatment are not included.

description_ja: 直接症候性症例1例当たり0.2例の追加下流症候性症例を仮定する静的境界解析。
description_en: Exploratory static bounding analysis with 0.2 additional downstream symptomatic cases per direct symptomatic case. Downstream cases are assigned the same high-risk conditional hospitalization and post-acute outcomes, making this an upper-bound static calculation.

description_ja: 直接症候性症例1例当たり0.5例の追加下流症候性症例を仮定する静的境界解析。
description_en: Exploratory static bounding analysis with 0.5 additional downstream symptomatic cases per direct symptomatic case. Downstream cases are assigned the same high-risk conditional hospitalization and post-acute outcomes, making this an upper-bound static calculation.

description_ja: SCORPIO-PEP日本地域（全リスク、mITT）の両群発症率（対照23.0%、PEP 4.1%）を用いる探索的解析。高リスク集団の観測値ではない。
description_en: Exploratory scenario using the observed arm-specific symptomatic risks in the Japan geographic region of SCORPIO-PEP (all risk levels; placebo 23.0%, ensitrelvir 4.1%). Downstream inputs remain those of the high-risk base case.

description_ja: 日本地域の対照群発症率23.0%に高リスクサブグループのRR 0.24を適用する探索的解析。
description_en: Exploratory scenario applying the high-risk subgroup risk ratio of 0.24 to the Japan-region placebo risk of 23.0%.

description_ja: 日本地域の対照群発症率23.0%に全体集団のRR 0.33を適用する保守的な探索的解析。
description_en: Conservative exploratory scenario applying the overall-trial risk ratio of 0.33 to the Japan-region placebo risk of 23.0%.

description_ja: 日本地域の両群発症率と、65歳以上無治療群の入院率1.298%を同時に適用する探索的結合シナリオ。
description_en: Exploratory joint scenario combining the observed Japan-region arm risks with the 1.298% hospitalization risk observed among untreated patients aged 65 years or older. Not an estimate for an observed population.

description_ja: 日本地域の対照群発症率23.0%に高リスクRR 0.24を適用し、免疫不全の入院率比2.60を同時に適用する探索的結合シナリオ。
description_en: Exploratory joint scenario combining the Japan-region placebo risk with the high-risk relative risk of 0.24 and the immunocompromised hospitalization-rate multiplier of 2.60. Not an estimate for an observed population.
